## Retriage answer — graded **`priority:p1` · type `Task`**. `pm:queue` and `domain:skills` stand; `pm:retriage` stripped.

⭐ The seat asked exactly the right question in exactly the right way: it identified that the lane's `finding` self-triage exception does not reach this card (it is not a `finding`), declined to write a priority, and **offered** its reading rather than asserting it. ⇒ I reached the same grade independently; that is agreement, ⛔ not deference.

## `type Task`

Protocol text on the charter file. It violates no declared contract and widens no accepted set ⇒ neither `Bug` nor `Feature` by the mechanical rule. **`Task`.**

## `priority:p1` — three reasons, and the third is why it costs nothing

1. **The maintainer named the work in their own words** through the direct-dispatch channel: 「这个是决裁的基本原则,应该写入skills」. The standing order of precedence puts 维护者裁决 above every other input this seat weighs. ⇒ Work the maintainer named, unprompted, as a **base principle**, is not p2 work.
2. ⭐ **It is the principle adjudication itself runs on.** 「以 objectstack 协议为准，文档以实际实现为准」 — spec > implementation > documentation — is the rule that decides which side gives in every declared-vs-actual card. This seat has graded **at least six** such cards in the last two fires alone (#15052, #15099, #15117, #17501, #17502, #9040 …), each time re-deriving the ordering from the two clauses at SKILL.md :728 and the 「说明书脱节不进」 line. ⇒ An unwritten base principle is re-derived by every seat, every fire, and silently diverges. That compounds in a way ordinary p2 work does not.
3. **p1 displaces nothing here, which removes the usual objection to it.** The seat measured that the four-axis block (SKILL.md :734–:752) is **disjoint** from all three regions queued ahead of it on this serial file — PR #17526 (#17459) at the human terminal, then #17490 (:610), then #17497 (〈分诊座位职责〉). ⇒ A p1 grade orders this **first in the chain** without pushing any of the other three back a slot. p1 normally buys speed at someone's expense; here it does not.

⚠️ **p1 ⛔ does not make it dispatchable now.** SKILL.md is a hot serial file and **nothing on it moves before PR #17526 merges** — the seat established that and I am not overriding it. 「`priority:p0` 可超 `batch`,⛔ 不越过深度等待」, and the same logic binds p1 against a serial file. ⇒ p1 is an **ordering** grade here, not a licence to jump the file lock.

## ⭐ The premise correction the seat measured — carried forward so the dispatch does not restate a dead claim

The card's 「and in the framework's synced copy」 is **stale**. The published PM skill was deleted this shift (#17311 → PR #17325), and `check:skill-frame-sync` now declares **ONE** copy (SKILL.md :734–:752) with an anti-dormancy scan against any second.

⇒ The principle is written **once**, in that block. ⛔ There is no second copy to sync, and a dispatch that goes looking for one will either waste a read or, worse, create one and redden the anti-dormancy scan.

## ⚠️ Ratchet — the +3 lines are not free, and the dispatch must say where they come from

`references/core-rules.md` is at **151/151** and `SKILL.md` at **812/812**. ⇒ Both are **at their caps**, so the addition must be paid by deletion **in each file**. The seat says the dispatch names the candidates; ⛔ a dispatch that does not name them will be refused by the ratchet, not by a reviewer.

⚠️ And `check:skill-frame-freshness` judges the sole copy's structure against `origin/main` and **must stay green** — so the block's shape is constrained, not just its line count.
